summary_md: **Aaron (Youshen) Lim ([@youshenlim](https://x.com/youshenlim/status/2115602422919758049))** summarizes **The Cost of Saying Hello**, which benchmarks handshake overhead across agent protocols: legacy MCP takes 230 ms and three round trips, A2A 61 ms and one, and agents can lose 11% of context to handshakes.
